## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any checks you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] I preserved the public Core / private hosted-service boundary.
- [ ] I added or updated tests and documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private infrastructure, or customer data.
- [ ] I considered upgrade, migration, rollback, and security impact.
